name: file-input
title: File Input
description: UI SDK FileInput styled as a drop zone with a browse button: accept, size and count limits, the chosen files as attachment chips with remove buttons, and why any were left out in the destructive tone.
docs: `<FileUpload title description browseLabel accept maxSize minSize maxFiles multiple validate name labels locale>` inside a `Field`: the field's label names the browse button (the field's control), drops, pastes inside the zone and the picker all go through the same checks, the chosen files show as `AttachmentThumb` chips (name, type, size from `formatFileSize`) with a remove button each, and rejected files are listed under the zone with their first reason (`labels.rejected`). `title`, `description` and `browseLabel` are your copy; `labels` (`list`, `remove`, `rejected`) default to English. Compose the parts (`FileInput`, `FileInputDropzone`, `FileInputTrigger variant size`, `FileInputFiles`, `FileInputRejections`, `FileInputList`, `FileInputItem`, `FileInputItemRemove`) for a button alone, a page-wide drop (`target="document"`) or a folder (`directory`). The value is `File[]`, so `FormField` binds it as is. With `name` it submits through a native file input.
